book.name: HEBREWS
book.title: HEBREW sinmuy amuṅaqw Tuptsiwni’yuṅqamuy amumi Pēni

content: Pi pep hin tutavo kihsit an hihta lolmat nātoniqat tuawi’ta; pam qa pas pas antsa pam’i; kurs pi hin pep hihtuy qö́yantiwyaqamuy aṅsakis yahsaṅwuy aṅ yūmosa pantsakiwhqa paṅso ökiwtaqamuy sūs lolmatani.
Pi as pantaniqw ya pam qa paṅso pay yukiwtani. Ispi pep okiwlalwaqam sūs powatote’, soon pāpu hīhihta qaanhtiput unaṅwpeq sunvoti’yuṅwni.
Noqw pi pep put pantsakiwhqat ep aṅsakis yahsaṅwuy ep qaanhtipu ahoy u’naniwṅwu,
Ispi soon wakastahtaqtuy pu kakapirstuy uṅwáam qaanhtiput haqami hintsanniq’ö.
Paniqw hapi ōviy Christ tūwaqatsit aw pitutoqe paṅqawu: Um hihtuy qö́yantiwyaqamuy‐nik̇aṅw pu ūmi ōoywaqat qa tuṅlay’ta; nihqe um inuṅem tokot na’sasta.
Um hihta ūmi tataqtsokwaqat pu qaanhtiput ep ūmi himu ōoywaqat ep qa nāhahlaytapna.
Pahsat pu nu paṅqawu: Meh, God, nu hapi uhtunatyay hinhtiniqey ōviy pitu; pay ura tutuvenit mupipitaqat ep nuy pan pēniwta.
Ura pam mohti paṅqawu: Um hihtuy tutavot an qö́yantiwyaqamuy‐nik̇aṅw pu ūmi ōoywaqat qa tuṅlay’ta; um hakiy qaanhtipuyat ep ūmi hihtuy tataqtsokwaqat ep qa nāhahlaytapna.
Pam pan lavayhtiqe pep pu’ piw paṅqawu: Meh God, nu hapi uhtunatyay hinhtiniqe ōviy pitu. Pam kítahqe mohtiwat ayo qenitat, aṅknihqat wunuptsina.
Noqw ōviy God tunatyayat ahpiy itam put eṅem sutsvo oyiwya, Christ itamuṅem tokoy sūs táviq’ö.
Ura God awwat momṅwit nāqavo put kīyat ep hoṅk̇ahk̇aṅw hihta hintsatsk̇aṅwu; pu pay nāt piw God eṅem hihtuy qö́yantotaṅwu, soon pi puma qaanhtiput haqami hintsanyaniq’ö.
Noqw pay Christ tuwat sinmuy qaanhtipuyamuy ep sūs nātapqe, pep pu’ pam God putvaqewat qatuptu;
Nihqe pahpiy put tuwqamat put aw maqaptsi’yuṅwniqat pam nuhtay’ta.
Pi pam pas sūs nātapqe God eṅem sutsvo oyiwyuṅqamuy pās hin hinyuṅwniqat pan sūs yuku.
Pi Qahováriwtaqa Hikwsi piw pas nāp put pantaqat itamuy āawna; ōviy pi ura as pay mohti paṅqawu:
It atsva pu’ nu yan amumi pasiwnani, kita Tutuyqawhqa: Nu unaṅwayamuy aṅ ilavayiy taṅatani, pu nu wuwniyamuy aṅ itutavoy pēnani.
Pu nu pumuy qaanhtipuyamuy‐nik̇aṅw pu nukpantuwiyamuy pāpu qa u’ni’tani, kita.
Noqw God hakiy qaanhtipuyat put aṅqw yukuqw, pep pāpu qaanhtiput ep himu nīniwhqa súlawni.
Let Us Come Near to God
Yanta hapi, itupkomu; noqw ōviy itam Jesus uṅwáyat aw yank̇ahk̇aṅw qa tuhtusk̇ahk̇aṅw haqam susqahovariwhput aw yuṅniniqw itamuṅem qeni.
Pi Jesus Christ pas nāp tokoy ahpiy soñawnen itamuṅem pöhut taytaqat yuku; noqw put tokoyat mötsáp’uhtsit antaqat aṅ itam God aw yuṅta.
Pi Christ itamuy God tímuyatuy amuṅem put awwat mohpeq moṅw’iwtaqey ep wunu.

Noqw ōviy itam suan unaṅway’k̇ahk̇aṅw, qa hin pēvewnayak̇ahk̇aṅw, God aw tuptsiwni’k̇ahk̇aṅw put aw ö́kini, itah’unaṅway Christ uṅwáyat akw pāhomiwyuṅqat navoti’k̇ahk̇aṅwo, hakiy kūyit akw tokoy pāhomhqat pan’i.
Pas itam qa wiwsiyak̇ahk̇aṅw God aw tuptsiwni’yuṅqey qa qe’totini. Pi i’ hak hin hintaniqat lavayhtiqa pas soon qa āantsani.
Pu itam hin nānami unaṅway’yuṅwniqey pu lolmat hintsatsk̇aniqey nāu’naṅwnayani.
Itam sūvo tsotsvalyaniqey qa qe’totini, haqawatuy amun’i; itam qa pumuy amún hinwist nāu’nantoynayani, tis ōviy’o, talöṅnit aw pitutoqw itam navoti’yuṅqee.
Ispi itam as hihta pas suyan pantaqat nanaptak̇aṅw, tuwat nāp itahtunatyay aṅ hinwise’ qaanhtotiqw, pay ahpiy pas qa himu haqam pāpu itahqaanhtipuy ep nīniwni.

Pánis‐sa hak pan hintsakqa navoti’taqw, God sinmuy sohsokmuy amuṅem hinwat yukune’, tuwqamuy amuhpewi itsívuy mahtakne’, qȫhit akw pumuy hovalani. Noqw hak it navoti’te’, tsawiniwk̇aṅw maqaptsi’taṅwu.
Ura pi hak Moses tutavoyat qa k̇aptsi’taqw, hakim lȫyöm sen pahyom put navoti’yuṅqam pan lavayhtotiqw, momṅwit put qa ōkwatutwat nīnayaṅwu.

Noqw hak God Tiyat pēvewnaqa hin tis pas pavan nuhtsel’ewakw sivihpit hihk̇ay’vani. Pam pi Qahováriwtaqat Hikwsit God núokwayat hakiy aw nóahqat qahihtata, piw Christ uṅwáyat aw wukukuyku, nāmahin pi as God put uṅwat akw put aw pasiwnat, nēṅem put sutsvo tavi.
Pi itam God yan hiṅqawhqat tuwi’yuṅwa: Ason nu hapi hakiy eṅem nāoyni; ason nu hihta ep hakiy aw ahoytamantani, kita Tutuyqawhqa; pu piw yanwata: Tutuyqawhqa sinomuy hin yukunani.
Pi pas God qátuhqat mapqölmiq posnaniqw, pam nuhtsel’eway’o.
Nīk̇aṅw pay kurs uma umuhhisatqatsiy aṅ wūwayani. Ura umuh’unaṅway tālawvaqw, uma qaan’ewakw hihta aṅ k̇ānanvotyak̇ahk̇aṅw aṅ kūkuyva.
Umuṅaqw haqawat sinmuy amutpik k̇ānanvotya, piw okiwhinyuṅwa; noqw umuhsuṅwamuy pan okiwsahsanyaqw, uma pumuy amumum k̇ānanvotya.

Oviy pi ura uma sivihpit aṅ taṅawtaqamuy ōkwatutwa; pu hihta umuhhimuy hovalayaqw, uma put ep qa hin unaṅwtoti, suyan pi uma ōveqatsit ep hihta pavan nukṅwa, pu pas qa hinhtiṅwuqat himuy’yuṅqey navoti’yuṅqe ōviy’o.
Oviy uma umuhqapevewniy qa aṅqw lasyani. Pi kurs uma yūmosa put aṅ hinwise’, hihta a’nö hihk̇ay’taqat ömahtotani.
Pay uma kurs hin sohsok hihta aṅ qa nakwhani’yuṅwni; nen uma God tunatyayat aṅ hinwisq, pam umuy hin āawnaqat uma put makiwyani.
Pay nāt hihsavoniqw i’ hak pítuniqa soon qa aṅqwni, nen soon sȫwuni.
Noqw i’ hapi súantaqa qapēvewniy akw qatsit tuwani; nīk̇aṅw kurs hakiy pay ahoy tu’qaltiqw, soon nu put ep hahlayni.
Noqw pay itam aṅ hakimuy tuptsiwnit aṅqw ahoy tu’qaltotiqe ayo maspiwhqamuy qa amunyuṅwa. Pi itam hapi tuptsiwnit aṅ ahsupoq hinwisq, itahhikwsi ayo yámakni.
